richiami.difetto: It has been identified that the roof vent/hood may have been fitted with the incorrect screws around the hinge area.  In additions some vents/hoods may not have been glued correctly. These issues could result in a detachment of the roof vent/hood which could pose a risk to other road users or pedestrians.
richiami.rimedio: Recall all affected vehicles to check to roof vents/hoods and repair as manufacturers instructions.

richiami.difetto: Due to an issue with the adhesive that attaches the window to the hinges may fail and in extreme circumstances the window may become detached from the vehicle.
richiami.rimedio: Recall all affected vehicles and replace the hinge securing system.

richiami.difetto: It is possible that water ingress into the fan motor could cause corrosion within the unit a possible short circuit or excessive heat build up. If not addressed this could result in a unit fire.
richiami.rimedio: Recall all affected units for the replacement of the fan motor and installation of additional fuses for improved units.
